description: The specified existential composition graph strongly represents a composite function whenever the constituent graphs strongly represent their functions in \(Q\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.composition_stronglyRepresents {m n : ℕ} (f : (Fin m → ℕ) → ℕ)
  (g : Fin m → (Fin n → ℕ) → ℕ) (φ : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin m ⊕ Unit))
  (ψ : Fin m → Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin n ⊕ Unit))
  (hf : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.StronglyRepresents f φ)
  (hg : ∀ (i : Fin m), Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.StronglyRepresents (g i) (ψ i)) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.StronglyRepresents (fun x => f fun i => g i x)
    (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.compositionGraph φ ψ)
